scope: Independent conditional sensitivity to unmeasured grey supernova luminosity evolution; not an empirical host-age correction.

smooth01.basis: four natural cubic splines through z=[0,.1,.4,.8,1.3], fixed zero at z=0

sign: prediction = geometrical distance modulus + luminosity term + free constant M; positive linear coefficient makes standardized SNe dimmer at z=1.
integration: Whiten the released full covariance and project the common magnitude before integrating the linear coefficient with its normalized bounded prior or Gaussian spline coefficients with their normalized priors. Retain determinant factors.
exact_background: Use CAMB get_background with the same modern physical inputs. Never call CAMB for native CMB spectra in this lane.
final_weight: Untrimmed exp(original exact/proposal log_weight + integrated SN alternative loglike - baseline SN loglike); no Pareto smoothing or truncation in posterior weights.
qualification: Require all overlap/stability gates plus passed parent convergence and exact-correction checks. Provisional chain snapshots are always unqualified. Failed overlap requires separate sampling or another validated bridge, never a claimed robust posterior.
validation: Compare bounded analytic integration with independent adaptive quadrature, low-rank Gaussian integration with direct augmented-covariance GLS including determinants and M normalization, and CAMB background SN values with already native-evaluated points. Include signs, large offsets, tails, constant-mode degeneracy and known-weight diagnostics.
limitations: Weight ESS is not autocorrelation-adjusted posterior ESS; finite diagnostics cannot certify coverage of remote modes. No model evidence or physical correction measurement follows. These sensitivities retain all upstream released-distance and cross-probe assumptions.
